label: Cover
notes: One line: Doctor is the health and diagnostics authority of the pyforge factory — sound machinery before the run, a finger on the fleet's pulse after the ship. Its instruments already exist across atlas and warden; Doctor is the consolidation.

label: Act I — The Physician
notes: Act I: who Doctor is. It verifies the machinery is sound before the factory runs, and keeps monitoring the shipped estate afterward — diagnosing faults early, prescribing the fix before an outage.

label: Preventive vigilance
notes: Mindset one: a fault caught in triage is cheaper than one caught in production. The self-check runs before the factory spins — a missing engine or broken config fails fast, never mid-build.

label: Continuous pulse
notes: Mindset two: never one-and-done. Once packages ship, Doctor keeps watching — freshness and drift, new advisories, abandonment signals — surfacing regressions the moment they appear.

label: Act II — The practice
notes: Act II: the practice — the three duties and their CLI.

label: The three duties
notes: The three duties and their CLI: pre-flight diagnostics before Marshal spins the factory; continuous fleet monitoring across the shipped estate; and remediation guidance — findings translated into prioritized worklists.

label: Act III — Organs that already beat
notes: Act III: Doctor is the consolidation of instruments the factory already runs — not an invention from scratch.

label: Existing instruments
notes: The instruments Doctor unifies: the atlas health surface (feedstock-health, staleness-report, behind-upstream), the atlas advisory watch (cve-watcher, release-cadence, adoption signals), and the engine self-check pattern from Warden. One bedside manner over all of them.

label: Prescriptions, not reports
notes: The differentiator: Doctor never stops at a finding. Every diagnosis names the root cause and comes with an ordered remediation plan — what to patch, upgrade or retire, in what order.

label: Keep the ecosystem alive
notes: Close on the motto: check the vitals, diagnose the fault, keep the ecosystem alive. The factory only stays autonomous if something is always watching its health.
